system.description: You sew shut the mouth of a leather mask while thinking of a creature you can see or name.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts until the next day begins.
outcomes.success: The creature is Silenced for 1 hour. You may store its voice in a jar; while you hold the jar, you can speak with its exact voice and cadence.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the stitches will not hold.
outcomes.ruin: The stitches close your own mouth: you are Silenced for 1 hour. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
